basic.label: Gear Reduction System

subordinate.label: Weighted Pendulum
subordinate.description: A weight that swings freely with limb movement

subordinate.label: Tiny Gearbox
subordinate.description: Miniature gear assembly connecting pendulum to generator

idea: A compact device worn on a limb or integrated into the exercise equipment, where a weighted pendulum swings with body motion, driving a tiny gearbox and generator to charge a battery.

superordinate.label: Mechanical Deformation Harvesting
superordinate.description: Generating energy by capturing physical stress, pressure, or shape changes caused by movement.

basic.label: Piezoelectric Transduction
basic.description: Utilizing materials that generate an electric charge in response to applied mechanical stress (compression and bending).

subordinate.label: Embedded Flexible Piezoelectric Pads/Strips
subordinate.description: Flexible piezoelectric materials integrated into wearable gear like shoe soles, knee braces, or grip handles.

idea: Flexible pads or strips made of piezoelectric material embedded in shoe soles, knee braces, or grip handles, converting the compression and bending from exercise into electricity.

superordinate.label: Linear Kinetic Energy Harvesting
superordinate.description: Capturing energy from linear oscillating motion induced by body movement.

basic.label: Electromagnetic Induction via Sliding Mass
basic.description: Generating electrical current by moving a magnetic mass linearly through a conductive coil.

subordinate.label: Tube-Encased Sliding Magnet & Coil
subordinate.description: A sealed tube with a magnet sliding inside and wire coils wrapped around it.

idea: A small, sealed tube containing a magnet that slides back and forth through a coil as the device (worn on an arm, leg, or part of a resistance band) moves, generating pulsed direct current.

superordinate.label: Cyclic deformation energy harvesting
superordinate.description: Capturing energy through repeated physical distortion and relaxation of a material driven by user movement.

basic.label: Stretchable soft-material generator
basic.description: Utilizing a compliant, elastic material system that generates electricity when mechanically elongated or contracted.

basic.label: Wearable textile integration
basic.description: Embedding the functional mechanism directly into clothing or fabric accessories worn on the body.

subordinate.label: Dielectric Elastomer Generator (DEG)
subordinate.description: Specific smart material technology composed of flexible, fabric-like bands made of DEG.

subordinate.label: Compression garments / Resistance bands
subordinate.description: Specific types of athletic wear or exercise equipment into which the material is integrated.

idea: A flexible, fabric-like material or band made of DEG, integrated into compression garments or resistance bands, generating power as it stretches and relaxes with body movements.

superordinate.label: Fluid displacement energy conversion
superordinate.description: Using fluid motion driven by physical compression to transfer mechanical work into electrical energy.

basic.label: Hydraulic compression drive
basic.description: A system where physical force displaces liquid through a contained path to spin a turbine.

basic.label: Rotational generation
basic.description: Converting rotational mechanical energy into electrical current.

subordinate.label: Self-contained hydraulic system
subordinate.description: A closed-loop fluid mechanism responding to limb movements like knee bends or bicep curls.

subordinate.label: Micro-turbine and generator
subordinate.description: Specific small-scale hardware used to capture the fluid flow and generate power.

idea: A small, self-contained hydraulic system where compression from a limb movement (e.g., knee bend, bicep curl) displaces a tiny amount of fluid, driving a micro-turbine and generator.

superordinate.label: Regenerative kinetic energy harvesting
superordinate.description: The broad mechanism of capturing energy specifically from the momentum of a system as it slows down or resists motion.

basic.label: Deceleration-activated mechanical coupling
basic.description: A mechanism that selectively connects the power source to the generator only during the slowing-down phase of motion.

subordinate.label: Clutch-like mechanism on moving part
subordinate.description: A specific clutch device attached to a component like a spinning wheel or resistance arm that engages a micro-generator.

idea: A clutch-like mechanism attached to a moving part (e.g., a spinning wheel on a stationary bike, or a resistance arm) that engages a micro-generator only when the motion is slowing down, converting the "braking" force into electricity.

superordinate.label: Discrete Motion Capture
superordinate.description: Mechanism for capturing distinct, irregular physical movements.

superordinate.label: Mechanical Energy Regulation
superordinate.description: Process of converting stored potential energy into a consistent output flow.

basic.label: Ratcheting Energy Storage
basic.description: Using a one-way mechanism to incrementally load potential energy into a storage component.

basic.label: Steady Mechanical Release
basic.description: A system that allows stored mechanical energy to unwind or release at a controlled, constant speed.

subordinate.label: Spring
subordinate.description: The specific elastic component used to store the energy from push-ups or arm swings.

subordinate.label: Gearbox to Generator
subordinate.description: The specific transmission and electrical components used to convert the unwinding motion.

idea: A device where each significant movement (e.g., a full push-up, a complete arm swing) ratchets a spring, which then unwinds steadily through a gearbox to power a small generator.

superordinate.label: Fluid dynamic energy harvesting
superordinate.description: Exploiting the movement of a fluid medium surrounding the user to generate power.

basic.label: Air displacement capture
basic.description: Using the resistance or flow of air created by body movement to drive a rotational generator.

subordinate.label: Miniature turbine with specialized blades
subordinate.description: An ultra-low-friction, small-scale rotor mounted on wearable straps.

idea: A tiny, ultra-low-friction turbine with specially designed blades, strategically placed on an arm band or chest strap, to capture and convert the kinetic energy of air displacement caused by exercise into electricity.

superordinate.label: Resonant Frequency Amplification
superordinate.description: Utilizing the phenomenon of resonance to maximize mechanical energy capture from periodic input forces.

basic.label: Tuned Oscillator System
basic.description: A mechanical system calibrated to match specific input frequencies to induce high-amplitude oscillation for energy harvesting.

basic.label: Motion-to-Electricity Transduction
basic.description: The conversion of mechanical kinetic energy directly into electrical energy.

subordinate.label: Cantilever or Mass-Spring System
subordinate.description: Specific mechanical arrangements used to create the oscillating mass.

subordinate.label: Piezoelectric or Electromagnetic Transducer
subordinate.description: Specific technologies used to perform the final energy conversion.

idea: A lightweight device containing a finely tuned oscillating cantilever or mass-spring system, which, when excited by typical exercise frequencies, resonates strongly, converting the amplified mechanical energy into electricity via a piezoelectric or electromagnetic transducer.

superordinate.label: Contact electrification energy harvesting
superordinate.description: Harvesting energy through the accumulation of electric charge resulting from materials touching and separating.

basic.label: Triboelectric effect via friction/separation
basic.description: Using friction or separation between disparate material layers to induce static charge transfer.

subordinate.label: Multi-layered wearable fabric patch
subordinate.description: A fabric or patch composed of multiple layers that rub or separate during skin contact, stretching, or bending.

idea: A multi-layered fabric or wearable patch where different layers rub or separate with human motion (e.g., stretching, bending, skin contact), generating a static charge that is then harvested as electrical energy.

superordinate.label: Thermal Energy Harvesting
superordinate.description: Utilizing heat differentials naturally occurring during physical activity to generate power.

basic.label: Skin-Surface Thermoelectric Conversion
basic.description: Capturing the temperature gradient between the user's skin and the ambient air using direct-contact conversion elements.

subordinate.label: Flexible TEG Patch
subordinate.description: An array of thermoelectric generators integrated into a wearable patch that conforms to the body.

idea: A small, flexible patch containing an array of thermoelectric generators (TEGs) worn directly against the skin. It converts the temperature differential between the warm body surface and the cooler ambient air into usable electricity, especially during exercise when body heat production is elevated.

superordinate.label: Biochemical Energy Harvesting
superordinate.description: Utilizing biological byproducts to drive energy generation processes.

superordinate.label: Fluid-Based Reactant Transport
superordinate.description: Capturing and moving liquid substances to a reaction site.

basic.label: Metabolic Electron Generation
basic.description: Using biological organisms to convert organic substrates into electrical current.

basic.label: Passive Fluid Collection
basic.description: Gathering bodily fluids directly from the source for processing.

subordinate.label: Sealed Microbial Fuel Cell
subordinate.description: A chamber containing bacteria that consume sweat to produce electricity.

subordinate.label: Sweat Intake Mechanism
subordinate.description: A wearable interface that channels perspiration into the device.

idea: A compact, wearable device that collects sweat and feeds it into a sealed microbial fuel cell chamber. The metabolic activity of the resident bacteria generates a continuous low-level electrical current, which can be stored in a small battery.

superordinate.label: Electrostatic Energy Harvesting
superordinate.description: Scavenging energy from static electrical charges generated by surface interactions.

basic.label: Passive Triboelectric Charge Collection
basic.description: Accumulating fluctuating electrical potentials resulting from friction and contact between materials without active mechanical generation.

basic.label: Impedance-Matched Power Conditioning
basic.description: Using circuitry to optimize the transfer of high-voltage/low-current static charges into usable current.

subordinate.label: Sensitive Strategic Electrodes
subordinate.description: Electrodes placed to target charge sources like hair, clothing layers, and skin-air friction.

subordinate.label: Impedance Matching Circuit
subordinate.description: Specific circuit implementation that converts fluctuating potentials into DC power.

idea: A device with sensitive, strategically placed electrodes and an impedance matching circuit that passively collects charge build-up from the moving body (e.g., from hair, clothing layers, skin-air friction) and converts these fluctuating potentials into usable DC power.

superordinate.label: Fluid displacement energy conversion
superordinate.description: Utilizing the displacement of a medium to drive a power generation system.

superordinate.label: Wearable compression harness
superordinate.description: Capturing kinetic force through direct surface contact with body expansion.

basic.label: Valve-regulated fluid circuit
basic.description: A system that directs fluid flow unidirectionally through a harvester using pressure differentials.

basic.label: Muscle expansion actuation
basic.description: Mechanism actuated by the radial expansion of contracting muscle tissue.

subordinate.label: Microchannels with micro-turbine
subordinate.description: Tiny internal channels equipped with one-way valves feeding a turbine generator.

subordinate.label: Flexible sleeve construction
subordinate.description: A band or sleeve worn around limbs like the calf or forearm.

idea: A flexible sleeve or band worn around a contracting muscle (e.g., calf, forearm). Internal microchannels with one-way valves are repeatedly compressed by the muscle, "milking" a small amount of fluid through a tiny turbine connected to a generator.

superordinate.label: Rotational Inertia Harvesting
superordinate.description: Extracting energy by resisting changes to the axis of rotation of a mass.

basic.label: Gyroscopic Torque Conversion
basic.description: Translating the resistive torque generated by reorienting a spinning mass into mechanical drive.

subordinate.label: Geared Mechanism with Pre-spun Flywheel
subordinate.description: A flywheel maintained in rotation coupled with gears to transfer torque to a generator.

idea: A small device containing a pre-spun flywheel (initial spin-up by hand or minimal power, then maintained). As the device is moved and its orientation changes with limb movements, the resulting gyroscopic torque is captured via a geared mechanism to spin a micro-generator, harvesting energy from the body's efforts to reorient the device.

superordinate.label: Thermal Energy Harvesting
superordinate.description: Exploiting temperature differentials to drive mechanical work

superordinate.label: Motion Rectification
superordinate.description: Converting oscillating mechanical motion into unidirectional rotation

basic.label: Shape Memory Thermal Cycling
basic.description: Using material phase changes triggered by body heat and ambient cooling to create cyclic mechanical displacement

basic.label: Ratchet-Based Transmission
basic.description: A mechanical linkage that converts linear contraction/relaxation cycles into continuous rotation

subordinate.label: SMA Wires/Springs on Patch
subordinate.description: Shape Memory Alloy elements embedded in a wearable band or patch

subordinate.label: Ratchet and Micro-generator
subordinate.description: A small ratchet mechanism connected to a micro-generator unit

idea: A band or patch where SMA wires or springs are strategically placed. Body heat causes them to contract, while ambient air allows them to relax. This repeated mechanical cycling (acting as a miniature heat engine) drives a small ratchet mechanism that turns a micro-generator.

superordinate.label: Electromagnetic Induction via Material Deformation
superordinate.description: Generating electricity by mechanically altering the magnetic properties of a material through physical deformation.

basic.label: Magnetoelastic Strain Energy Conversion
basic.description: Utilizing the change in magnetic permeability caused by mechanical strain to induce electrical current in a conductor.

basic.label: Flexible Form Factor
basic.description: A pliable structure capable of stretching or bending to capture kinetic motion.

subordinate.label: Magnetoelastic Material & Sensing Coil
subordinate.description: A specific pairing of strain-sensitive magnetic material with an adjacent conductive coil.

subordinate.label: Flexible Strip or Band
subordinate.description: A specific physical implementation shaped as a strip or band designed to be stretched or bent.

idea: A flexible strip or band containing a magnetoelastic material and an adjacent sensing coil. As the strip is stretched or bent with human motion, the mechanical strain alters its magnetic properties, inducing a current in the coil.

superordinate.label: Chemical Potential Energy Conversion
superordinate.description: Generating power by exploiting chemical differences rather than kinetic motion.

basic.label: Osmotic Ion Exchange
basic.description: Using ion-exchange membranes to separate solutions of different salinity, where osmotic potential drives ion flow to generate current.

subordinate.label: Sweat-Based Microfluidics
subordinate.description: A wearable device utilizing sweat channels as the high-salinity input source against a low-salinity solution.

idea: A small, wearable device that collects sweat and directs it through a series of channels separated by ion-exchange membranes from a lower-salinity solution. The osmotic potential drives ion flow, creating an electrical current across electrodes.

superordinate.label: Variable Capacitance Energy Harvesting
superordinate.description: Generating electrical energy by exploiting changes in the electrical capacity of a system caused by mechanical motion.

basic.label: Fluid-Based Electrostatic Transduction
basic.description: Using the physical displacement of a conductive liquid relative to electrodes to alter capacitance and induce current.

subordinate.label: Flexible Microfluidic Device
subordinate.description: A sealed, flexible unit containing conductive fluid and embedded electrodes that shifts with limb movement.

idea: A sealed, flexible microfluidic device with embedded electrodes and a conductive fluid. As the device moves with a limb, the fluid shifts, continuously altering the capacitance of the system. This change can be used to generate voltage/current.

superordinate.label: Fluid-structure interaction
superordinate.description: Exploits the interaction between a moving object and the surrounding fluid (air) to generate mechanical energy.

superordinate.label: Vibration energy harvesting
superordinate.description: Captures generated mechanical oscillations to produce electrical power.

basic.label: Vortex-induced vibration mechanism
basic.description: Uses a bluff body to create flow disturbances (vortices) that drive a spring-mass system into oscillation.

basic.label: Electromechanical transduction
basic.description: Converts mechanical oscillatory motion into electrical energy.

subordinate.label: Cylindrical or finned bluff body
subordinate.description: Specific geometry attached to the spring-mass system that sheds vortices.

subordinate.label: Piezoelectric or electromagnetic transducer
subordinate.description: Specific physical components used to perform the energy conversion.

idea: A lightweight device with a specially designed cylindrical or finned element (bluff body) attached to a spring-mass system. As the limb moves through the air during exercise, it creates miniature vortices that induce vibrations in the element. These amplified vibrations are then converted into electricity via a piezoelectric or electromagnetic transducer.

superordinate.label: Mechanical deformation harvesting
superordinate.description: Harvesting energy through physical deformation of materials

superordinate.label: Wearable integration
superordinate.description: Integrating the harvesting mechanism directly into worn items

basic.label: Strain gradient induction
basic.description: Generating electricity via localized strain gradients caused by bending

basic.label: Joint articulation attachment
basic.description: Positioning energy harvesters at points of body articulation or equipment flex

subordinate.label: Flexoelectric filaments
subordinate.description: Flexible strips or filaments made of flexoelectric material

subordinate.label: Apparel joints
subordinate.description: Elbow or knee sleeves and resistance bands

idea: Flexible strips or filaments made of a flexoelectric material could be integrated into the joints of exercise clothing (e.g., elbow or knee sleeves) or resistance bands. As these areas bend and straighten during exercise, the localized strain gradients induce an electric current that can be harvested.

superordinate.label: Fluid-Based Kinetic Energy Harvesting
superordinate.description: Exploiting the kinetic displacement of a liquid medium relative to a solid substrate to generate power.

basic.label: Droplet-Electrode Interface Movement
basic.description: Generating electrical charge through the agitation and sliding motion of conductive liquid droplets across a patterned surface.

basic.label: Wearable Integration
basic.description: Embedding the energy harvesting mechanism into accessories attached to the body.

subordinate.label: Micro-Patterned Electrodes & Encapsulated Droplets
subordinate.description: An array of micro-patterned electrodes interacting with tiny, encapsulated conductive liquid droplets.

subordinate.label: Shoe Sole or Wristband Housing
subordinate.description: A compact, sealed device integrated into specific locations like a shoe sole or wristband.

idea: A compact, sealed device integrated into a shoe sole or wristband, containing an array of micro-patterned electrodes and tiny, encapsulated conductive liquid droplets. As the device moves or experiences impact/pressure from exercise, the droplets are agitated and slide across the electrodes, generating small bursts of electrical energy that can be collected.

superordinate.label: Bio-fluid Energy Harvesting
superordinate.description: Extracting energy from biological fluids rather than purely mechanical motion.

superordinate.label: Mechanical Fluid Transport
superordinate.description: Using physical movement to drive fluid dynamics within a system.

basic.label: Electrochemical Reaction
basic.description: Generating electrical current through chemical interactions between a fluid electrolyte and electrodes.

basic.label: Peristaltic Pumping
basic.description: Using compression forces to actively move fluid through channels.

subordinate.label: Dissimilar Metal Electrodes in Sweat
subordinate.description: Specific implementation using sweat as the electrolyte reacting with different metal electrodes.

subordinate.label: Muscle Contraction on Micro-channels
subordinate.description: Using the specific force of muscle contractions to compress micro-channels in a skin patch.

idea: A flexible patch worn on the skin, featuring micro-channels that collect sweat. Muscle contractions or limb movements are used to mechanically compress these channels, actively "milking" the sweat through a reaction chamber containing carefully chosen dissimilar metal electrodes, thereby generating a continuous electrical current.

superordinate.label: Fluidic Energy Harvesting
superordinate.description: Utilizing fluid displacement caused by body movement to drive an energy conversion system.

superordinate.label: Wearable Integration
superordinate.description: Attaching the energy harvesting mechanism directly to the limbs to capture kinetic motion.

basic.label: Rectified Fluid Flow System
basic.description: A system that converts oscillating fluid movement into unidirectional flow using check valves and channels to drive a generator.

basic.label: Limb-Mounted Compression
basic.description: A mounting structure that utilizes the natural movement of arms or legs to actuate the system.

subordinate.label: Micro-channel Network with Air Turbine
subordinate.description: Intake/exhaust vents, micro-channels, fluidic check valves, and a miniature air turbine/generator.

subordinate.label: Arm or Leg Band
subordinate.description: A specific band designed to be worn on the arm or leg.

idea: A device integrated into an arm or leg band, featuring intake and exhaust vents and an internal network of micro-channels with fluidic check valves. As the limb moves, air is drawn in and pushed out, but the internal system ensures a one-way flow, creating a steady airflow to power a miniature air turbine and generator.

superordinate.label: Magnetohydrodynamic Energy Conversion
superordinate.description: Generating electricity by moving a conductive fluid through a magnetic field.

superordinate.label: Fluid-Based Motion Capture
superordinate.description: Translating body movement into fluid displacement.

basic.label: Liquid Conductor Induction
basic.description: Using liquid metal flow across stationary magnetic fields to induce current.

basic.label: Flexible Channel Compression
basic.description: Utilizing wearable deformation to pump fluid through internal pathways.

subordinate.label: Non-toxic Liquid Metal & Embedded Magnets
subordinate.description: Specific use of sealed non-toxic liquid metal flowing past permanent magnets.

subordinate.label: Micro-channeled Flexible Sleeve
subordinate.description: A wearable band or sleeve containing sealed micro-channels.

idea: A flexible band or sleeve containing sealed micro-channels filled with a non-toxic liquid metal and embedded permanent magnets. As the user's limb flexes or moves, the liquid metal is forced to flow through the channels and across the magnetic fields, generating an electrical current directly within the liquid conductor.

superordinate.label: Mechanical-to-optical energy conversion
superordinate.description: Transforming kinetic force into light energy as an intermediate state.

superordinate.label: Optical-to-electrical energy harvesting
superordinate.description: Capturing emitted light and transforming it into usable electricity.

basic.label: Stress-activated chemiluminescence
basic.description: Release of light energy triggered by physical pressure or rupture of chemical containers.

basic.label: Photovoltaic capture
basic.description: Absorption of photons by a semiconductor material to generate electric current.

subordinate.label: Rupturing microcapsules with reagents
subordinate.description: Layers of microscopic capsules containing chemiluminescent chemicals that break upon muscle impact.

subordinate.label: Embedded miniature photovoltaic cell
subordinate.description: Small solar-style cells integrated into the flexible pad.

idea: A flexible pad or band containing multiple layers of microcapsules filled with chemiluminescent reagents. Mechanical stress from muscle contractions or impacts during exercise ruptures these microcapsules, causing the reagents to mix and emit light. A miniature, embedded photovoltaic cell then captures this light and converts it into usable electrical energy.

superordinate.label: Thermal-driven Fluid Transport
superordinate.description: Using a temperature differential to induce the directed movement of a fluid.

superordinate.label: Hydro-mechanical Energy Conversion
superordinate.description: Transforming the kinetic energy of a moving fluid into electrical energy.

basic.label: Thermal Gradient Membrane Transport
basic.description: Utilizing body heat to create a temperature difference across a barrier, forcing liquid molecules to migrate from the warm side to the cool side.

basic.label: Fluid Flow Turbine Generation
basic.description: Channeling a directed liquid stream to rotate a mechanical turbine mechanism.

subordinate.label: Porous Membrane Sweat Patch
subordinate.description: A wearable patch containing a porous membrane that moves sweat via body heat differential.

subordinate.label: Sweat-driven Micro-turbine
subordinate.description: A micro-turbine spun by the channeled flow of collected sweat.

idea: A wearable patch that collects sweat. Body heat creates a temperature gradient across a porous membrane within the device, causing water molecules to move from the warmer (skin-side) to cooler side, creating a directed flow of sweat. This induced flow is channeled to spin a micro-turbine, generating electricity.

superordinate.label: Acoustic/Pressure Wave Harvesting
superordinate.description: Harvesting energy by capturing vibrational waves generated by body mechanics rather than direct kinetic movement.

basic.label: Resonant Transduction Interface
basic.description: A mechanism that captures acoustic or pressure waves through sensitive membranes or cavities and converts vibrations into electrical signals.

basic.label: Wearable Integration
basic.description: Embedding the harvesting unit directly into worn accessories or apparel.

subordinate.label: Piezoelectric Microphone/Cavity Array
subordinate.description: A microphone-like array or tuned resonant cavity utilizing piezoelectric membranes.

subordinate.label: Garment/Brace Mounting
subordinate.description: Integration into a knee brace, shoe sole, or compression garment.

idea: A small, highly sensitive microphone-like array or a tuned resonant cavity with piezoelectric membranes, integrated into a knee brace, shoe sole, or compression garment. It captures the acoustic energy or pressure waves from specific body mechanics and converts them into electricity.

superordinate.label: Hydroelectric energy conversion
superordinate.description: Utilizing fluid movement and ionic interactions to generate electrical potential.

superordinate.label: Passive fluid collection
superordinate.description: Mechanisms for gathering biological fluids without external mechanical pumps.

basic.label: Streaming potential generation
basic.description: Generation of voltage via the flow of an ionic fluid through charged micro/nano-pathways.

basic.label: Capillary/compression-driven intake
basic.description: Using physical material properties or muscle movement to force fluid through a medium.

subordinate.label: Charged nanochannels/porous membrane
subordinate.description: Specific structures used to create the narrow pathways necessary for the streaming potential effect.

subordinate.label: Flexible patch drawing sweat
subordinate.description: The specific form factor and fluid source identified in the design.

idea: A flexible patch with embedded nanochannels or a specialized porous membrane that selectively draws in sweat. As sweat is forced or flows through these charged micro/nano-channels due to muscle compression or capillary action, a streaming potential is generated, which is then harvested as electricity.

superordinate.label: Flow-Induced Vibration Energy Harvesting
superordinate.description: Utilizing relative airflow generated by motion to induce mechanical instability and oscillation for energy capture.

basic.label: Resonant Galloping/Flutter Mechanism
basic.description: An aerodynamic instability phenomenon where a structure oscillates at high amplitude due to fluid flow, amplifying the mechanical energy available for harvesting.

basic.label: Aerodynamic Profile Element
basic.description: A flexible component designed with specific geometry to interact with airflow during limb movement.

basic.label: Mechanical-to-Electrical Conversion
basic.description: The translation of amplified low-frequency oscillation into usable electrical power.

subordinate.label: Low-Frequency Oscillation
subordinate.description: The specific type of mechanical vibration caused by the galloping or flutter effect.

subordinate.label: Elastic Band with Shaped Cross-Section/Fins
subordinate.description: The specific implementation of the aerodynamic element, such as a resistance band or garment strap with attached fins.

subordinate.label: Linear or Rotational Micro-Generator
subordinate.description: The specific hardware used to convert the oscillation into electricity.

idea: An elastic band or strap (e.g., a resistance band or part of a wearable garment) with a specially shaped cross-section or attached fins. As the limb moves, airflow induces resonant galloping or flutter in this element, causing significant mechanical vibration. This amplified, low-frequency oscillation drives a linear or rotational micro-generator.

superordinate.label: Gravitational potential energy storage
superordinate.description: The system operates by capturing kinetic energy and storing it temporarily as potential energy against gravity before conversion.

basic.label: Gravity-driven mechanical powertrain
basic.description: A mechanism that utilizes the descent of a raised mass to drive a generator through mechanical transmission components.

basic.label: Unidirectional motion capture
basic.description: A mechanism that captures motion in one direction (raising) to position the energy source, while disengaging or controlling the return stroke.

subordinate.label: Internal mass, micro-generator, and gearbox
subordinate.description: An internal weight that descends to spin a micro-generator via a reduction gearbox.

subordinate.label: Ratchet and one-way clutch
subordinate.description: Specific mechanical components used to lift the mass during the raising phase and drive the generator during the lowering phase.

idea: A compact device worn on a wrist or ankle. As the limb is raised (e.g., during a bicep curl or leg lift), it ratchets an internal mass upwards. As the limb lowers, the mass descends slowly under gravity, turning a micro-generator via a reduction gearbox and one-way clutch, converting its stored potential energy into electricity.

superordinate.label: Thermal Phase-Change Energy Harvesting
superordinate.description: Harvesting energy by exploiting temperature differentials to trigger reversible physical property changes in a material.

superordinate.label: Magnetic Induction Generation
superordinate.description: Generating electricity through the interaction of changing magnetic fields and conductors.

basic.label: Thermomagnetic Cycle
basic.description: A process where a material's magnetic state oscillates between magnetic and non-magnetic due to cyclic heating and cooling.

basic.label: Variable Flux Induction
basic.description: Inducing an electric current in a coil by varying the magnetic flux density near it.

subordinate.label: Gadolinium Alloy Skin-Air Cycling
subordinate.description: Use of a Gadolinium alloy positioned to cycle between warm skin contact and cooler ambient air exposure.

subordinate.label: Inductive Coil Pickup
subordinate.description: An inductive coil placed near the changing magnetic material to capture the current.

idea: A small device with a thermomagnetic material (e.g., a specific Gadolinium alloy) positioned to be cyclically exposed to warm skin and cooler ambient air as the limb moves. Body heat causes the material to heat up and become non-magnetic, reducing its interaction with an external magnet. As it cools in ambient air, it regains magnetism. This repeated change in magnetization near an inductive coil generates an electric current.

superordinate.label: Passive fluid dynamics
superordinate.description: Utilizing natural fluid movement without external mechanical pumping to drive a system.

superordinate.label: Electrokinetic energy conversion
superordinate.description: Converting the kinetic energy of fluids or ions directly into electrical potential.

basic.label: Evaporation-induced capillary pumping
basic.description: Using the phase change of liquid at an interface to create a pressure deficit that draws fluid through a system.

basic.label: Ion-selective streaming potential
basic.description: Generating a voltage difference by forcing an ionic fluid to flow through a selective barrier that separates charges.

subordinate.label: Sweat wicking in micro-channels
subordinate.description: Micro-channels that draw sweat via wicking action followed by surface evaporation.

subordinate.label: Ion-selective membranes with electrodes
subordinate.description: Membranes that filter ions between embedded electrodes to capture voltage.

idea: A flexible patch containing micro-channels and ion-selective membranes. Sweat is drawn into the capillaries by wicking. As sweat evaporates from the surface of the patch, it creates a continuous, directed flow of fluid within the micro-channels, effectively "pumping" ions across the membranes and generating a voltage difference between embedded electrodes, which can then be harvested.

superordinate.label: Mechanical deformation energy harvesting
superordinate.description: Harvesting energy by converting mechanical stress or shape changes into electrical potential.

basic.label: Variable capacitance generation
basic.description: Generating current through the continuous alteration of capacitance via physical displacement of conductive elements relative to electrodes.

subordinate.label: Encapsulated liquid droplet array
subordinate.description: A flexible arrangement of conductive liquid droplets over micro-electrodes and a dielectric layer that change shape or contact area under force.

idea: A flexible device with an array of micro-electrodes covered by a dielectric layer and populated with tiny, encapsulated conductive liquid droplets. As the device is flexed, compressed, or impacted during exercise, the mechanical force alters the droplet shape and contact area with electrodes, or induces specific droplet movements, which continuously changes the system's capacitance and generates an electrical current.

superordinate.label: Fluidic induction harvesting
superordinate.description: Utilizes the movement of a fluid to generate electricity through electromagnetic induction.

superordinate.label: Mechanical shear deformation
superordinate.description: Harvests energy by leveraging shear forces created by body movement to drive a mechanism.

basic.label: Liquid magnetohydrodynamic drive
basic.description: Pumping a conductive liquid past a magnetic field to induce current in coils.

basic.label: Deformable channel pump
basic.description: A soft structure that pumps fluid when deformed by external shear forces.

subordinate.label: Micro-channels with conductive liquid and magnets
subordinate.description: Embedded micro-channels filled with conductive liquid that flows near a permanent magnet and coils.

subordinate.label: Viscoelastic gel sleeve
subordinate.description: A flexible sleeve or pad with a viscoelastic gel layer that deforms under muscle contraction.

idea: A flexible sleeve or pad containing a viscoelastic gel layer and embedded micro-channels with a conductive liquid. As the muscle contracts or limb moves, the shear forces deform the gel. This deformation then cyclically compresses the micro-channels, pumping the conductive liquid through a section containing a permanent magnet, inducing an electrical current in nearby coils.

superordinate.label: Acoustic Energy Harvesting
superordinate.description: Capturing and converting sound waves generated by the body into electrical power.

basic.label: Metamaterial-Enhanced Acoustic Focusing
basic.description: Using engineered structural geometries to manipulate, absorb, and concentrate sound waves onto a transducer.

basic.label: Piezoelectric Transduction
basic.description: Converting mechanical stress from sound pressure into electrical charge.

subordinate.label: Labyrinthine Channel / Sub-wavelength Resonators
subordinate.description: Specific engineered metamaterial structures used to trap and amplify sound.

subordinate.label: Sensitive Piezoelectric Membrane
subordinate.description: The specific component that receives the focused sound waves.

idea: A small, wearable device containing a specially engineered metamaterial structure (e.g., a labyrinthine channel or an array of sub-wavelength resonators) that acts as a super-absorber and concentrator for body-generated sounds. The focused and amplified sound waves then impact a highly sensitive piezoelectric membrane, converting the enhanced acoustic energy into electricity.

superordinate.label: Electrostatic Surface Interaction
superordinate.description: Generation of electrical energy through the physical interaction and separation of material surfaces.

basic.label: Non-contact Triboelectric Induction
basic.description: Utilizing friction to build charge and variable separation distance to induce voltage in isolated electrodes.

subordinate.label: Multi-layered Textile Patch with Embedded Electrodes
subordinate.description: A flexible wearable patch or textile containing un-contacted electrodes that rubs against skin or clothing.

idea: A flexible, multi-layered patch or integrated textile worn under clothing. As clothing layers rub against each other or against the skin due to body motion, they build up electrostatic charges. As these layers repeatedly separate and come together, they induce a voltage in strategically placed, un-contacted electrodes embedded within the device, similar to a non-contact electrostatic generator.

superordinate.label: Electromagnetic Induction via Fluid Dynamics
superordinate.description: Generating electricity by utilizing the movement of a magnetically responsive liquid relative to a conductor.

superordinate.label: Inertial Mass Oscillation
superordinate.description: Utilizing the physical displacement of an internal mass caused by external body movement.

basic.label: Variable Magnetic Flux via Ferrofluid
basic.description: Using the shifting shape and position of a magnetic fluid to alter the magnetic field passing through inductive coils.

basic.label: Externally Guided Fluid Sloshing
basic.description: Using magnets to direct the random flow of fluid within a container during motion.

subordinate.label: Embedded Coils and Ferrofluid
subordinate.description: A sealed chamber containing ferrofluid that moves past wire coils embedded in the structure.

subordinate.label: External Permanent Magnets
subordinate.description: Small magnets placed outside the flexible tube to interact with the internal ferrofluid.

idea: A sealed, flexible tube or chamber containing a ferrofluid and embedded coils, with small external permanent magnets. As the device moves with a limb, the ferrofluid sloshes and shifts. The external magnets guide and interact with this movement, causing localized internal fluid flow or magnetic field changes that induce current in the coils.

superordinate.label: Biochemical and Thermal Energy Harvesting
superordinate.description: Utilizing metabolic byproducts and thermal gradients produced by the body to generate power.

basic.label: Dual-Responsive Electrochemical Conversion
basic.description: A system where electricity is generated through chemical reactions modulated by both temperature differentials and acidity changes.

subordinate.label: Sweat pH and Heat Sensitive Wearable Patch
subordinate.description: A wearable patch housing an electrochemical cell with electrodes reacting to sweat pH fluctuations and body heat increases.

idea: A wearable patch containing an electrochemical cell with electrodes specifically designed to be sensitive to both temperature gradients and the changing pH levels of sweat. As body heat increases and sweat pH fluctuates during exercise, these combined effects drive a flow of electrons through an external circuit, generating electricity.

superordinate.label: Chemical potential energy conversion
superordinate.description: Utilizing chemical gradients or potentials inherent in bodily fluids to drive a system.

basic.label: Osmotic pressure actuation
basic.description: Using the absorption and release of fluid driven by concentration differences to create mechanical expansion and contraction.

basic.label: Mechanical transmission
basic.description: Transferring linear displacement into generator input.

subordinate.label: Hydrogel/polymer swelling chamber
subordinate.description: A chamber containing specialized hydrogel or polymer that interacts with sweat.

subordinate.label: Piston linkage to micro-generator
subordinate.description: A piston connected via linkage to a micro-generator.

idea: A device containing a specialized hydrogel or polymer chamber. When exposed to sweat (which has a higher solute concentration), the gel absorbs water and swells, exerting pressure or moving a piston. As sweat is removed or evaporates (thereby changing the osmotic potential), the gel contracts. This cyclic swelling and contraction, driven by the presence and changing concentration of sweat, directly drives a micro-generator via a mechanical linkage.

superordinate.label: Optical strain sensing energy conversion
superordinate.description: Utilizing light modulation through physical deformation to generate energy.

basic.label: Period-variable optical grating modulation
basic.description: Modulating a light source by altering the period of a grating structure through mechanical stretching or bending.

basic.label: Photovoltaic signal harvesting
basic.description: Converting modulated light signals into electrical energy.

subordinate.label: Fiber Bragg grating / Photonic crystal strip
subordinate.description: A flexible strip containing a fiber Bragg grating or specially patterned photonic crystal integrated into a resistance band or joint sleeve.

subordinate.label: Miniature photodiode
subordinate.description: A specific component used to capture modulated light and generate an electrical signal.

idea: A flexible strip containing a fiber Bragg grating or a specially patterned photonic crystal. As the strip stretches or bends with body motion (e.g., integrated into a resistance band or joint sleeve), the grating period changes, modulating a low-power internal light source passed through it. The modulated light is then captured by a miniature photodiode, generating an electrical signal proportional to the strain, which can be harvested.

superordinate.label: Fluid-Mechanical Energy Harvesting
superordinate.description: Exploiting fluid dynamics and surface tension gradients to generate mechanical movement.

superordinate.label: Kinetic-to-Electric Transduction
superordinate.description: Converting small-scale mechanical motion into electrical energy.

basic.label: Evaporation-Driven Capillary Flow
basic.description: Creating continuous fluid movement through narrow channels driven by evaporation and wetting properties.

basic.label: Micro-fluidic Mechanical Actuation
basic.description: Using fluid flow within a sealed chamber to physically displace a mechanical element.

subordinate.label: Micro-capillaries with Surface Treatments
subordinate.description: An array of micro-capillaries featuring hydrophobic and hydrophilic surfaces to manage sweat absorption and wicking.

subordinate.label: Miniature Propeller or Oscillating Flap
subordinate.description: A small rotating propeller or flapping mechanism housed within a sealed chamber.

idea: A small, wearable device with an array of micro-capillaries and hydrophobic/hydrophilic surfaces. As sweat is absorbed from the skin, it wicks through the capillaries. Evaporation from the exposed surface of the capillaries creates a continuous capillary flow, driving a miniature propeller or a small oscillating flap within a sealed chamber, which in turn drives a micro-generator.

superordinate.label: Bio-potential Field Harvesting
superordinate.description: Capturing energy from the naturally occurring, non-contact electrical field fluctuations generated by biological processes.

basic.label: Non-contact Field Distortion Detection
basic.description: Sensing minute changes in localized electrical fields caused by underlying physiological activity without direct skin contact.

basic.label: Signal Conditioning and Rectification
basic.description: Processing detected minute potential changes into usable DC electrical energy.

subordinate.label: Passive Electrodes and Ultra-low Power Amplifier
subordinate.description: An array of sensitive passive electrodes combined with an amplifier to pick up muscle and ionic flow distortions.

subordinate.label: Wearable Patch Form Factor
subordinate.description: The physical housing for the conditioning circuitry.

idea: A non-contact, wearable patch containing an array of highly sensitive passive electrodes and an ultra-low power amplifier. It detects the tiny, localized electrical field distortions generated by underlying muscle activity and ionic flow in sweat. These minute, dynamic potential changes, akin to changes in a bioelectric field, are then conditioned and rectified into harvestable electrical energy.

superordinate.label: Direct Electrochemical Conversion
superordinate.description: The system converts mechanical energy into electrical energy through direct modification of chemical reaction rates rather than mechanical generators.

basic.label: Mechanosensitive Redox Modulation
basic.description: Mechanical deformation (bending, compressing) induces structural changes that enhance the rate of redox reactions within an electrochemical cell.

subordinate.label: Solid-State Flexible Electrolyte System
subordinate.description: The implementation uses embedded solid-state electrodes and a mechanosensitive electrolyte/separator capable of handling bending and stretching.

idea: A flexible device with embedded solid-state electrodes and a mechanosensitive electrolyte/separator. As the device is bent, compressed, or stretched during exercise, the mechanical forces induce structural changes that directly enhance the rate of redox reactions within the cell, causing it to generate or discharge electricity that can be stored in a small capacitor or battery.

superordinate.label: Inertial energy harvesting via magnetic induction
superordinate.description: Capturing kinetic energy from body movement using non-contact forces to minimize mechanical loss.

superordinate.label: Rectification of erratic motion
superordinate.description: Converting bidirectional or irregular acceleration forces into unidirectional mechanical work.

basic.label: Magnetic levitation potential wells
basic.description: Using repulsive magnetic fields to suspend a mass and create force gradients that drive motion.

basic.label: Asymmetrical force stepping
basic.description: A mechanism that biases motion in a single direction through uneven force distribution or mechanical constraints.

subordinate.label: Levitated magnet on opposing magnet track
subordinate.description: A lightweight magnet suspended over a track of precisely spaced opposing magnets.

subordinate.label: One-way clutch and generator
subordinate.description: A clutch mechanism connected to a generator that captures the forward stepping motion.

idea: A compact device with a lightweight magnet levitated over a track made of precisely spaced opposing magnets. As the device moves with a limb, the subtle acceleration and deceleration causes the levitated magnet to "step" forward along the track (due to asymmetrical magnetic potential wells), driving a tiny one-way clutch and generator. This provides near-frictionless energy capture from erratic motion.

superordinate.label: Aerodynamic Pressure Harvesting
superordinate.description: Capturing energy from localized air pressure fluctuations generated by rapid object motion through a fluid medium.

basic.label: Resonant Diaphragm Oscillation
basic.description: Utilizing a tuned cavity to resonate with external pressure waves, amplifying the force to drive an oscillating membrane.

subordinate.label: Sealed Chamber with Flexible Diaphragm
subordinate.description: A specific enclosure design acting as a tuned resonator connected to a micro-generator.

idea: A small, sealed chamber with a flexible diaphragm (acting as a tuned resonator) attached to a micro-generator. As the limb moves rapidly through the air, it creates localized air pressure fluctuations. The chamber's design resonates with these pressure waves, causing the diaphragm to oscillate with amplified force, which then drives a small electromagnetic or piezoelectric generator.

superordinate.label: Pneumatic Energy Conversion
superordinate.description: Utilizing compressed gas as an intermediate medium to capture and transfer kinetic energy.

basic.label: Gas Compression and Release Cycle
basic.description: Mechanical force compresses gas into storage, which is subsequently released to drive a turbine.

basic.label: Limb-Actuated Compression
basic.description: Harnessing the rhythmic movement of extremities to provide the mechanical compression force.

subordinate.label: Piston, Accumulator, and Air Turbine
subordinate.description: A small piston forces air into a high-pressure accumulator which feeds a miniature air turbine.

subordinate.label: Ankle or Wrist Band Integration
subordinate.description: A compact device worn on the ankle or wrist that actuates during footfall or arm swing.

idea: A compact device integrated into an ankle or wrist band. Each significant limb movement (e.g., footfall, arm swing) momentarily compresses a small piston, forcing air into a tiny high-pressure accumulator. The accumulated pressure is then bled off at a controlled rate through a miniature air turbine, driving a micro-generator.

superordinate.label: Indirect energy harvesting
superordinate.description: Harvesting energy by modulating an external energy source via mechanical deformation rather than direct conversion.

basic.label: Strain-modulated optical gating
basic.description: Using mechanical strain to alter material optical properties, thereby controlling light transmission to a generator.

basic.label: Photovoltaic generation
basic.description: Converting received light into electrical energy.

subordinate.label: Mechanochromic polymer coating
subordinate.description: A flexible strip coated with a polymer that changes color or transparency when stretched or bent.

subordinate.label: Thin photovoltaic film backing
subordinate.description: A PV film layer positioned behind the strip to capture the modulated light.

idea: A flexible strip coated with a mechanochromic polymer and backed by a thin photovoltaic film. As the strip is stretched or bent with body motion (e.g., on a resistance band or glove), its color or transparency changes. This modulates the amount of ambient light reaching the PV cell, generating a variable electrical output that can be harvested.

superordinate.label: Bio-electrochemical Harvesting
superordinate.description: Generating power by converting chemical energy found in biological fluids into electricity.

basic.label: Enzymatic Oxidation Catalysis
basic.description: Using biological catalysts to facilitate an oxidation-reduction reaction that releases harvestable electrons from a fluid substrate.

subordinate.label: Lactate-Oxidase Skin Patch
subordinate.description: A flexible wearable containing electrodes coated with lactate oxidase enzymes to react with sweat.

idea: A flexible, multi-layered patch worn on the skin. The patch contains electrodes coated with specific enzymes (e.g., lactate oxidase) and a proton exchange membrane. As sweat containing lactate reaches the enzyme-coated anode, the enzyme catalyzes the oxidation of lactate, releasing electrons that are harvested. A corresponding cathode completes the circuit, generating electricity.

superordinate.label: Stabilization of unstable mass
superordinate.description: Utilizing the body's natural postural adjustments and limb movements to exert stabilizing forces on an unstable system.

superordinate.label: Mechanical motion conversion
superordinate.description: Converting captured physical oscillations and micro-stabilizing forces into usable energy.

basic.label: Multi-stage inverted pendulum system
basic.description: A system of nested or stacked unstable weights that require continuous force to prevent falling.

basic.label: Geared linkage transmission
basic.description: A mechanical connection system designed to capture small oscillations and drive power generation components.

subordinate.label: Nested 'Russian doll' configuration
subordinate.description: Specific implementation where inverted pendulums are contained within one another to save space.

subordinate.label: Micro-generators
subordinate.description: Small-scale electrical generators driven by the geared linkages.

idea: A compact device containing a small, multi-stage inverted pendulum system (like Russian dolls of inverted pendulums) mounted on a limb. As the user moves, the body's natural postural adjustments and limb movements continuously exert small forces to prevent the pendulums from falling. These micro-stabilizing forces and the resulting small oscillations are captured via geared linkages to drive a series of micro-generators.

superordinate.label: Electrostatic transduction via deformation
superordinate.description: Generating electricity by mechanically deforming a material to alter its electrical properties.

superordinate.label: Body-conforming integration
superordinate.description: Incorporating the active mechanism directly into flexible equipment that moves with the user.

basic.label: Variable capacitance via dielectric modulation
basic.description: Utilizing stress-induced changes in a material's dielectric constant to fluctuate capacitance for energy harvesting.

basic.label: Flexible substrate embedding
basic.description: Embedding the active components into a pliable material that can bend and stretch.

subordinate.label: Electrostrictive polymer with embedded electrodes
subordinate.description: A film or pad made of electrostrictive polymer containing electrodes.

subordinate.label: Compression sleeve or exercise mat
subordinate.description: Specific workout gear into which the polymer film is integrated.

idea: A flexible film or pad made of an electrostrictive polymer with embedded electrodes is integrated into a compression sleeve or exercise mat. As the material is stretched, bent, or compressed by body movements, its dielectric constant changes, causing a measurable change in its capacitance. This capacitance fluctuation is then converted into usable electrical energy by an associated harvesting circuit.

superordinate.label: Polarization-based mechanical energy conversion
superordinate.description: Generating electricity by altering the internal polarization state of a material through physical deformation.

basic.label: Stress-induced ferroelectric domain switching
basic.description: Applying mechanical stress to reorient ferroelectric domains, generating an electrical pulse via polarization change.

subordinate.label: Flexible PVDF-TrFE polymer or ceramic film
subordinate.description: A thin layer of specific ferroelectric materials like PVDF-TrFE or ceramics integrated into wearable locations.

idea: A thin, flexible film of a ferroelectric polymer (e.g., PVDF-TrFE) or ceramic integrated into a shoe sole or joint brace. Each step or joint flexion applies mechanical stress, causing a momentary switching of the ferroelectric domains within the material, which generates a brief but distinct electrical current pulse as the stored polarization is reoriented.

superordinate.label: Inertial Mass Displacement
superordinate.description: Harvesting kinetic energy through the movement of an internal mass relative to the device frame.

basic.label: Granular Dynamics Conversion
basic.description: Using the sloshing, jamming, and unjamming behaviors of granular matter to generate variable pressure forces.

basic.label: Mechanical Force Transmission
basic.description: Transferring internal pressure variations into linear motion or deformation to drive a generator.

subordinate.label: Conductive Granular Media
subordinate.description: Sealed chamber filled with metallic beads or sand.

subordinate.label: Piston/Membrane Mechanism
subordinate.description: Small piston or internal membrane connected to a micro-generator.

idea: A small, sealed, lightweight chamber filled with conductive granular material (e.g., metallic beads or sand). As the device (worn on a limb or integrated into equipment) moves or is impacted, the granular material "sloshes," jams, and unjams. The pressure variations and forces generated during these transitions are used to drive a small piston or deform an internal membrane, which then powers a micro-generator.

superordinate.label: Magnetohydrodynamic Energy Conversion
superordinate.description: Utilizing magnetic fields to manipulate fluid dynamics for the purpose of kinetic energy harvesting.

superordinate.label: Turbine-Based Generation
superordinate.description: Converting fluid flow into electrical energy via rotational mechanics.

basic.label: Dynamic Magnetic Gradient Pumping
basic.description: Generating fluid flow through the interaction of static magnets and moving magnetic fluid suspensions triggered by external motion.

basic.label: Micro-Hydraulic Turbine Drive
basic.description: Using a miniaturized turbine system to capture energy from a pumped fluid stream.

subordinate.label: Ferrofluid-Filled Micro-Channels
subordinate.description: A flexible band containing sealed channels filled with non-toxic magnetic nanoparticle suspension and embedded permanent magnets.

subordinate.label: Tiny Turbine Generator
subordinate.description: A small-scale turbine mechanism mechanically linked to a generator.

idea: A flexible band containing sealed micro-channels filled with a non-toxic magnetic nanoparticle suspension (ferrofluid) and embedded miniature permanent magnets. As the user's limb moves, the dynamic interaction between the moving device, its internal magnets, and the magnetic particles creates localized, time-varying magnetic field gradients that "pump" the fluid, directing it through a tiny turbine connected to a generator.

superordinate.label: Distributed Mechanical Energy Harvesting
superordinate.description: Capturing kinetic energy from widespread surface deformations.

superordinate.label: Motion Rectification and Aggregation
superordinate.description: Converting irregular, multi-directional inputs into a single continuous output.

basic.label: Array of Deformable Elastic Elements
basic.description: Using a dense collection of flexible components to absorb kinetic energy through compression, stretching, or twisting.

basic.label: Mechanical Linkage System
basic.description: A mechanism that connects distributed inputs to transfer force to a central point.

subordinate.label: Micro-fabricated Compliant Springs
subordinate.description: Small-scale springs embedded within a flexible mat or fabric patch.

subordinate.label: Common Shaft with Micro-ratchets
subordinate.description: A specific drivetrain assembly that translates spring deformations into rotational motion for a micro-generator.

idea: A flexible, mat-like device or fabric patch embedded with a dense array of micro-fabricated compliant springs. As different parts of the device are compressed, stretched, or twisted by body movements (e.g., from a footfall or arm swing), the individual springs deform. These deformations are mechanically linked to a common shaft or a series of micro-ratchets that translate the erratic, distributed input into a smoother, continuous rotational motion to power a micro-generator.

superordinate.label: Fluid-Surface Interaction Energy Harvesting
superordinate.description: Generating electrical energy by exploiting the interaction between a moving conductive fluid and a solid surface structure.

basic.label: Streaming Potential Generation
basic.description: Creating an electrical potential difference through the flow of an electrolyte (sweat) across a charged or structured interface.

basic.label: Passive Fluid Transport
basic.description: Moving fluid through the system using intrinsic physical forces rather than external pumps.

subordinate.label: Nanostructured Microchannels
subordinate.description: Microchannels featuring nanostructured or hydrophilic/hydrophobic surfaces to interact with moving water molecules.

subordinate.label: Capillary Action and Body Pressure
subordinate.description: Mechanisms used to drive sweat flow through the patch's channels.

idea: A flexible patch containing microchannels with specially designed nanostructured or hydrophilic/hydrophobic surfaces. As human sweat is wicked or flows across these surfaces due to capillary action or pressure from body movements, the interaction between the moving water molecules and the surface creates a streaming potential. This potential difference is then collected by electrodes embedded in the patch to generate electrical power.

superordinate.label: Mechanical-to-Electrical Transduction via Molecular Manipulation
superordinate.description: The system generates energy by translating macroscopic mechanical force into microscopic molecular state changes.

basic.label: Molecular Machine Switching Mechanism
basic.description: Utilizing the physical displacement or electronic state change of molecular-level components within a material matrix to generate charge redistribution under strain.

subordinate.label: Rotaxane-Doped Polymer Film/Fiber
subordinate.description: A flexible polymer material embedded with synthesized molecular rotaxane switches that shift rings along an axle when stretched or bent.

idea: A flexible polymer film or fiber doped with carefully synthesized molecular rotaxane switches. When the film is subjected to mechanical strain (stretching, bending) from exercise, the mechanical force causes a reversible displacement of the molecular rings along their axle, or a change in their electronic state. This molecular-level "switching" directly generates tiny electrical impulses or current through charge redistribution, which can be harvested.

superordinate.label: Pneumatic Flow Rectification
superordinate.description: Capturing erratic fluid movement and stabilizing it for conversion.

superordinate.label: Active Flow Control
superordinate.description: Using a secondary powered mechanism to regulate the primary energy conversion process.

basic.label: Fluidic Oscillation Transformation
basic.description: Converting irregular, low-frequency airflow into a consistent, high-frequency oscillating stream.

basic.label: Electromagnetic Modulation
basic.description: Applying a magnetic field to precisely control fluid dynamics within the system.

basic.label: Oscillatory Flow Harvesting
basic.description: Extracting electrical energy specifically from pulsed or vibrating fluid motion.

subordinate.label: MEMS-scale Fluidic Oscillator
subordinate.description: A micro-electro-mechanical system designed to create fluid oscillation.

subordinate.label: Small Electromagnet & Capacitor
subordinate.description: A tiny magnet powered by a capacitor charged by initial motion.

subordinate.label: Micro-turbine or Piezoelectric Membrane
subordinate.description: Specific transducers mentioned for converting the pulsed flow into electricity.

idea: A small, sealed device integrated into a garment, with an air inlet/outlet. Erratic air movement from a moving limb enters a MEMS-scale fluidic oscillator. This oscillator, precisely controlled by a tiny electromagnet (powered by a small capacitor charged by initial motion), transforms the turbulent, low-frequency air input into a stable, high-frequency oscillating airflow within a closed loop. This consistent, pulsed flow then efficiently spins a micro-turbine or vibrates a piezoelectric membrane to generate electricity.

superordinate.label: Distributed Energy Harvesting
superordinate.description: Collecting power from a dispersed area rather than a single point source.

superordinate.label: Constructive Signal Processing
superordinate.description: Optimizing energy output by algorithmically aligning multiple input sources.

basic.label: Sensor Array Integration
basic.description: Using a grid of multiple sensing elements to capture localized physical inputs across a surface.

basic.label: Phase-Alignment Amplification
basic.description: Processing signals to combine them constructively based on phase and amplitude characteristics.

subordinate.label: Piezoelectric Fabric Grid
subordinate.description: A flexible, multi-layered patch containing numerous tiny piezoelectric elements.

subordinate.label: Micro-controller Algorithms
subordinate.description: Integrated processing using algorithms similar to phased array antennas or active noise cancellation.

idea: A flexible, multi-layered fabric or patch containing a grid of numerous tiny piezoelectric elements, worn over a muscle group or joint. Each element detects localized micro-vibrations and deformations. An integrated micro-controller processes the phase and amplitude of these signals from the array, applying algorithms (similar to those used in phased array antennas or active noise cancellation systems, but in reverse) to constructively combine and amplify the harvested electrical output from the distributed mechanical energy.

superordinate.label: Linear motion damping and harvesting
superordinate.description: Utilizing linear movement to simultaneously provide resistance and capture energy.

superordinate.label: Variable resistance control
superordinate.description: Dynamically adjusting the difficulty of movement through active material properties.

basic.label: Electromagnetic induction harvester
basic.description: A system where relative motion between a conductor and a magnetic field generates electricity.

basic.label: Magnetorheological fluid damping
basic.description: Using a fluid that changes viscosity under a magnetic field to create adjustable resistance.

subordinate.label: Piston-coil assembly
subordinate.description: A piston moving within an electromagnetic coil surrounding a chamber.

subordinate.label: MR fluid chamber
subordinate.description: A specific chamber filled with MR fluid subjected to a magnetic field from a surrounding coil.

idea: A compact device, similar to a miniature shock absorber, worn on a limb. A piston moves within a chamber filled with MR fluid as the limb moves. An electromagnetic coil surrounding the chamber generates a magnetic field, dynamically controlling the fluid's viscosity and thus the damping resistance. As the piston moves and shears the MR fluid through this magnetic field, an electrical current is induced in the coil, effectively converting the energy of human movement and damping into usable electricity.

superordinate.label: Humidity Gradient Harvesting
superordinate.description: Exploiting the natural humidity differential created near the skin during physical activity to drive mechanical work.

superordinate.label: Cyclical Mechanical Actuation
superordinate.description: Using repetitive environmental changes to create reciprocating motion for energy conversion.

basic.label: Hygroscopic Material Expansion
basic.description: Utilizing a material that changes physical volume or shape in response to moisture absorption and desorption.

basic.label: Mechanical Linkage Transmission
basic.description: A mechanism that translates small-scale material deformation into rotational or linear motion for a generator.

subordinate.label: Hygroscopic Polymer Film/Fiber
subordinate.description: Layers of specific polymer material contained within a lightweight band or patch.

subordinate.label: Micro-ratchet / Lever Arm
subordinate.description: Small mechanical components connecting the expanding material to a tiny generator.

idea: A lightweight band or patch containing layers of a hygroscopic polymer film or fiber. As the limb moves during exercise, these layers are cyclically exposed to varying humidity levels (e.g., higher humidity near the skin, lower in the ambient air). This repeated expansion and contraction of the material drives a micro-ratchet or lever arm connected to a tiny generator, converting the energy from humidity gradients into electricity.

superordinate.label: Acoustic/Vibration Energy Harvesting
superordinate.description: Capturing energy dissipated as sound waves or vibrations generated by body movement.

basic.label: Fluid-Driven Electromagnetic Induction
basic.description: Utilizing the movement of a fluid induced by external waves to interact with electrical coils for power generation.

subordinate.label: Micro-fluidic Channels with Coils
subordinate.description: A fabric patch containing micro-channels filled with viscous fluid and embedded coils.

idea: A lightweight patch or fabric woven with sound-absorbing materials that integrate micro-generators. For instance, micro-channels filled with a viscous fluid and embedded coils, where the energy of the impinging sound waves causes controlled fluid movement that induces an electric current. As the body moves, generating subtle sounds and vibrations, these waves are absorbed, and the dissipated energy is converted into electricity.

superordinate.label: Fluid dynamic pressure harvesting
superordinate.description: Exploiting ambient pressure differentials created by movement through a fluid medium to perform work.

basic.label: Differential pressure actuation
basic.description: Using the difference between external dynamic air pressure and an internal reference pressure to deform a flexible structure.

basic.label: Mechanical-to-electrical transduction
basic.description: Converting structural deformation into electrical energy.

subordinate.label: Flexible bellows/diaphragm with internal volume
subordinate.description: A sealed, flexible component containing a reference volume of air.

subordinate.label: Micro-generator (Piezoelectric/Electromagnetic)
subordinate.description: Specific transducers cited as examples for converting motion to electricity.

idea: A small, sealed, flexible device resembling a miniature bellows or diaphragm, worn on a limb. It contains an internal reference volume. As the limb moves rapidly through the air during exercise, it generates transient air pressure changes around the device. The device's flexible membrane or bellows reacts to these rapid, subtle pressure fluctuations, deforming to drive a micro-generator (e.g., a piezoelectric or electromagnetic transducer).

superordinate.label: Thermally-driven chemical energy conversion
superordinate.description: Utilizing heat differentials to initiate and sustain chemical reactions that produce energy.

basic.label: Thermal catalysis electrochemical harvesting
basic.description: Using elevated temperatures to drive catalytic oxidation-reduction reactions at electrodes to generate current.

subordinate.label: Solid-state catalytic patch
subordinate.description: A wearable patch using body heat to oxidize trace organics on skin/air via a solid-state catalytic cell.

idea: A wearable patch containing a miniature, solid-state catalytic cell. Body heat from exercise elevates the temperature on one side of the patch, enabling a reversible, catalytic oxidation-reduction reaction (e.g., mild oxidation of trace organics in ambient air or on skin) at a specific electrode. The subsequent electrochemical processes at another electrode then generate an electrical current.

superordinate.label: Fluid-driven electromagnetic generation
superordinate.description: The broad mechanism of generating electricity by utilizing the motion of a fluid to induce electromagnetic changes.

superordinate.label: Inductive current generation
superordinate.description: The general principle of generating electrical current via changing magnetic fields.

basic.label: Moving magnetic liquid medium
basic.description: The use of a liquid with magnetic properties that displaces or oscillates due to physical motion, serving as the variable magnetic source.

basic.label: Stationary inductive pickup
basic.description: A mechanism that detects changing magnetic flux from a moving source to generate electricity.

subordinate.label: Ferrofluid in microchannel network
subordinate.description: The specific implementation using non-toxic ferrofluid contained within a network of sealed microchannels.

subordinate.label: Micro-coils
subordinate.description: Small coils placed strategically to capture the magnetic field changes.

idea: A flexible, sealed microchannel network embedded into a wristband or compression sleeve, filled with a non-toxic ferrofluid. As the limb moves, the ferrofluid is subjected to accelerations, causing it to slosh and generate complex, localized capillary waves along the channel walls. Strategically placed micro-coils detect the localized magnetic field changes induced by these moving magnetic waves, generating an electrical current.

superordinate.label: Indirect energy conversion via optical modulation
superordinate.description: Converting mechanical strain into electrical energy through an intermediate step of modulating light properties.

basic.label: Mechano-optical transduction to photovoltaics
basic.description: Using mechanical deformation to alter the optical properties of a material, directing light to a photovoltaic converter.

subordinate.label: Photonic crystal polymer patch
subordinate.description: A flexible polymer film embedded with a photonic crystal structure that deforms to scatter light onto a miniature photovoltaic cell.

idea: A flexible patch or film made of a polymer embedded with a tailored photonic crystal structure. As the patch is stretched or bent by human motion (e.g., integrated into exercise clothing), the periodic structure deforms. This deformation causes the photonic crystal to selectively emit or scatter ambient light (or light from a low-power internal LED) in a way that is highly efficient for an integrated miniature photovoltaic cell, thus converting mechanical energy into light, then electricity.

superordinate.label: Electrohydrodynamic (EHD) conversion
superordinate.description: Generating electrical energy by moving charged fluids (air) through an electric field rather than moving solid conductors.

superordinate.label: Inertial/Fluidic coupling

idea: A small, sealed device worn near a joint or large muscle group. Body movements cause subtle vibrations, which are amplified and used to drive a piezoelectric transducer. This transducer generates ultrasound, inducing cavitation in an enclosed liquid. The thermal energy from the collapsing bubbles is then transferred to a tiny thermoelectric generator, converting it into electrical power.
